findings.text: Fallback export registration reports failure for registration, reports success for unregistration, and provides an empty buffer initialization operation.
Fallback trace array helpers report success or failure without action, return no array for lookup by name, and provide empty release operation.
Dynamic event field descriptor holds a pair of short values whose order swaps with endianness and is packed without padding.
Common event header carries a short type tag, flag and preemption bytes, and a process identifier.
Maximum event type is all bits set for the width of the header type field.

Iterator state bundles owning array and tracer references, per CPU iteration state, temporary formatting areas, sequencing state, position and timing cursors, CPU selection masks, and closed and snapshot markers.
Iterator contains a mutex used to serialize access to iteration state across open and read paths.
Iterator file option bits select latency formatting, annotation, nanosecond time display, and paused operation with successive powers of two.
Event operations bundle four output renderers and each registered event links a numeric type with a pointer to that bundle.
Line output result distinguishes retry after flush, consumed, relay to another renderer, and handled without consuming, in zero to three order.
Generic header fill derives preemption count from low context bits, process identity from current task, type from caller, and flags from high context bits.

Context flag set encodes interrupt disable, lazy and normal rescheduling need, hard and soft interrupt context, preempt rescheduling, non maskable context, and bottom half disable as successive single bits.
Context builders sample interrupt state into flags and optionally decrement the count when preemption support is enabled.
Command line and group identity recording options occupy the first two bit positions.
Registration operation enumerates plain registration lifecycle plus perf registration lifecycle and perf add and delete actions that can override default handling.
Field description carries type and name metadata with size alignment signedness test and filter attributes, or a callback that defines fields dynamically.
Event class describes system name, probes, registration callback, field array and accessors, field list, raw initialization, and optional tracing identifiers.
Reservation descriptor links output buffer, ring event, owning file, entry pointer, sampled context, and register state.

Event capability and kind flags cover capability bypass, filter control, enable handling, tracepoint origin, dynamic origin, probe families including kernel user embedded and function probes, custom origin, and string test mode.

Event call descriptor chains list membership, owning class, name or tracepoint identity, generic event header, print format, module or reference count union, private data, static flags, and perf state.
Dynamic reference helpers in this configuration never acquire a reference and always report busy, with an empty release operation.
Reference handling dispatches on dynamic origin between dynamic helpers and module reference counting.
Program array presence test is only a fast heuristic outside locking and may miss a concurrently installed array or observe one that disappears before use.
Event naming prefers tracepoint name when marked as tracepoint backed, otherwise uses the direct name, and field lookup prefers class callback over static list.
Per file state bits track enabled, recorded command and identity, filtering, filter control, soft and trigger modes and conditions, process filtering, prior enabled state, and freed state.
Per file descriptor links event call, filter, filesystem and array and subsystem owners, trigger list, atomic flag word, open reference count, and soft and trigger mode counts.
Flag word updates require atomic writes while reads may be unsynchronized with possible propagation delay across processors.
Dynamic event command length is bounded at two thousand forty eight and dynamic kinds enumerate synthetic, kprobe, and none starting at one.
Dynamic command builder holds output sequence state, event name, field count, kind tag, command runner, and private data.
Synthetic trace build state carries frame buffer, entry and buffer pointers, event pointer, field cursor, word count, and disabled and chaining markers.
Synthetic and probe command helpers forward construction and field addition to internal builders and finish by invoking dynamic creation.
History poll wakeup either queues work when sleepers exist or does nothing in the alternate configuration, with a wait helper bound to a shared queue.
Perf trace payload limit is eight thousand one hundred ninety two, filter string limit is two hundred fifty six, and event string limit is five hundred twelve.
Trigger kinds enumerate no action, tracing on off, snapshot, stack trace, event enable, event history, history enable, and embedded probe, with successive single bits after none.
Soft disable test uses a fast path for files without trigger soft disable or process filter modes and without trigger condition, otherwise defers to a slow helper.
Fallback tracing and perf program helpers report success for filter calls and report unsupported operation for attach query and multi attach operations.
Filter kinds distinguish generic values, static dynamic and related strings, pointer strings, function names, processor masks, command names, processor ids, and stack traces.
Perf buffer submission forwards raw payload size context type count register state and task identity to the tracepoint perf path.
Formatted length measurement duplicates variadic arguments, measures formatted output plus terminator, and clamps to the event string bound.
Custom event declaration macros expand to nothing in this configuration.
Null placeholder renders as a fixed parenthesized word and dump modes enumerate none all original and parameter selection.
Print helpers select a constant string fast path backed by a dedicated section versus a dynamic string path, with a compile time format check that never executes.
Relies on an external once read helper for the program array heuristic.
Relies on an external interrupt state predicate for context flag construction.
Relies on an external interrupt flag sampling operation for context creation.
Relies on an external configuration test for preemption adjustment.
Relies on an external sleeper test for history poll wakeup.
